- RSVP redirect: use one canonical RSVP URL that appends segment and variant as UTM params. Example: https://redwood.com/rsvp?utm_source=email&utm_medium=invite&utm_campaign=midmarket_jun16&utm_term=product_vA
- HubSpot: create two contact lists (midmarket_product, midmarket_infra) and a workflow that tags contacts with "webinar_midmarket_jun16" on click. I’ll share the list IDs below.
- AB test: subject lines A/B at send-level; track open->register conversion in HubSpot report.
